finding: All nine curated evidence packages already exist. The Evidence Explorer was empty because its loader did not recognize the canonical evidence_section_NN.json filenames. Its legacy extraction path also preferred argument-group citation-key strings over the rich findings array.

count_definitions.findings: Number of rich objects in each package's findings array.
count_definitions.papers: Unique non-empty DOI, falling back to citation key, among a section's findings. The per-section sum is not a global unique-paper count.
count_definitions.conflicts: Number of objects in each package's conflicts array. A conflict may intentionally appear in more than one section.
count_definitions.figure_comparisons: Number of objects in each package's figure_data array.
